answer: Two-hop fee trace. A new key earns nothing until the fee that opened it has passed through 2 established keys that do not share a funder, with 1 epoch, about 6 hours, between hops. Peers reject a hop already on file. A farm of 60 fake keys must buy 120 separate hops and wait 12 hours on each key. One shared hop is refused. The river of fees is public, a yarrow sample rechecks 10 percent of hops, and the basalt hold freezes payout until both hops are 6 hours old, so each extra fake costs 2 fees and 12 hours instead of one copied text.
